summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Impor Data' flow (Pilih Jenis Data -> Download Template -> Upload -> Pratinjau/Pemetaan+Validasi -> Konfirmasi Impor) for Supplier and Produk. All five review-request scenarios PASS: (1) three setup steps render with correct testIDs; (2) Download Template for Supplier triggers an .xlsx download (Template-Impor-supplier.xlsx) and import-done shows 'diunduh'; (3) column mapping accepts BOS labels (CSV headers 'Nama Supplier','Telepon','Kota' and produk labels) and the four statuses render correctly (Valid / Duplicate / Warning / Error); (4) Konfirmasi writes only Valid+Warning rows to SSOT — /more/supplier shows Toko Grosir Makmur added and CV Sumber Rezeki still appears only once; (5) Produk import: Teh Melati 25s = Valid (supplier 'CV Sumber Rezeki' resolved to master id), Kopi Duplikat KOP-250 = Duplicate ('SKU sudah ada di master'), Gula Semut 500g = Error with combined issues 'Supplier Utama: "Supplier Tidak Ada" tidak ditemukan di master · HPP Awal / Unit bukan angka'. After confirm, /more/produk shows Teh Melati 25s (with supplier 'CV Sumber Rezeki') and KOP-250 remains a single entry (duplicate not imported). No deprecated Expo packages detected in the touched files.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: pre-existing 'Require cycle: src/data/store.tsx -> src/hooks/useAnalyticsMonth.ts -> src/data/store.tsx' warning — unrelated to Import Data feature.

parseCsv in [slug].tsx uses a naive split on comma (no quote handling). Current test fixtures don't contain quoted commas so it works, but a value like a supplier name containing ',' would corrupt columns. Consider using a small CSV parser or XLSX round-trip for parity with .xlsx path — future hardening only.

validateRow currently marks the produk row as Error when HPP is 'abc' AND still records the 'Supplier Tidak Ada' warning inside issues[] — final status is Error (hasError wins), which is correct per the AND/OR requirement in the review spec. No change needed.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the app's built-in seed suppliers/products in localStorage; test uploads the two provided fixtures (supplier-import.csv, produk-import.csv).
context_for_next_testing_agent: State is client-side (localStorage key bos.data.v2). Re-running these tests in the same browser session will produce Duplicate for Toko Grosir Makmur / Teh Melati 25s the second time (already imported) — that is expected/correct behavior of the duplicate detection. Open in a fresh incognito to see seeded state again. Key testIDs: import-type-<slug>, import-download-template, import-pick-file, import-confirm, import-done. File upload is via expo-document-picker → hidden <input type=file>: intercept with page.expect_file_chooser then set_files. Mid-test the preview host briefly returned a Cloudflare 502 once; a simple retry (safe_goto) recovered fully — infra flake, not a code bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification only, no bug to fix.
